mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply crunch that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by > 2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Y/Y RSAFS growth > 10% AND Y/Y HOUST growth > 10%
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both grow > 10% Y/Y but SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 300,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS grows > 300k for 3 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months, it signals an inflationary spiral that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
candidate_trigger: M/M CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL grows > 0.5% M/M for 3 months but SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline year-over-year for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Y/Y GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline Y/Y for 2 quarters but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
